files.Summary: Represents a tag specifically for organizing and categorizing projects.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Abilities.AbilityDefinition
files.Summary: Represents a blueprint for an individual ability (e.g., "Fireball", "Shield Bash"). Defines the core mechanics, including type, resource cost, cooldowns, and scaling logic.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Abilities.AbilitySet
files.Summary: Represents a collection of abilities grouped together (e.g., a "Mage Ability Set"). This allows for defining complete skill sets for character classes or templates.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Abilities.StatusEffectDefinition
files.Summary: Represents a blueprint for a status effect (e.g., "Burning", "Stunned"). Defines how the effect behaves, including its type, duration, and potential damage per tick.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.AttributeDefinition
files.Summary: Represents a blueprint for a character attribute (e.g., "Strength", "Health", "Mana"). Defines the core mechanics, including data type, scaling formulas, and value constraints.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.AttributeSet
files.Summary: Represents a collection of attributes grouped together for a specific entity or template (e.g., "Core Stats", "Magic Attributes"). This allows for defining complete attribute systems tailored to different archetypes.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.CharacterAttributes
files.Summary: Represents the current concrete values for a specific attribute on a character. This entity tracks how an is manifested in a specific individual, including whether the value is derived from template scaling or manually overridden.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.ClassTemplate
files.Summary: Defines a template for a character class (e.g., "Warrior", "Mage") within the game's scaling system. This links a class name and description to a specific , establishing the baseline stats and level progression for that archetype.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.ClassTemplateAttribute
files.Summary: Represents a specific attribute configuration for a . This allows individual classes to have unique scaling formulas or value constraints for attributes defined in their parent .

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Attributes.GameTag
files.Summary: Defines tags used for categorizing game-related effects and mechanics (e.g., elements or status types).

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.EngineIntegration.EngineExportConfig
files.Summary: Defines the configuration settings for exporting project content to external game engines. This entity stores the target engine type, export format, and activation status.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.EngineIntegration.EngineFieldMapping
files.Summary: Maps internal content fields to their corresponding property names in a game engine. This facilitates the automated export of narrative data (e.g., Character Names, Item Stats) into engines like Unity or Unreal.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.EngineIntegration.GameKeyEvent
files.Summary: Represents a game-related event triggered by a specific narrative segment. This allows writers to embed interactive mechanics (like giving items or setting flags) directly into the story flow via scene segments.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.EngineIntegration.GameTriggerType
files.Summary: Defines the types of mechanical events that can be triggered within the narrative flow.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Inventory.EndingDefinition
files.Summary: Represents a predefined narrative ending within a project. Defines the criteria (via conditions) and description for how a player/character reaches this outcome.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Game.Inventory.InventoryItem
files.Summary: Represents a collectible, key, achievement, or currency item within a project's inventory system.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Identity.CharacterIdentity
files.Summary: Represents a character's identity assignment, linking a content item to specific identity definitions and values. Used for assigning traits such as race, faction, or guild to characters within the narrative structure.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Identity.IdentityDefinition
files.Summary: Defines the identity of an ability or property. Following Law I: This is a 1:1 extension of ContentMetaInfo, so Id == MetaInfoId.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Identity.IdentityValue
files.Summary: Represents a specific option within an identity category (e.g., "Human" within the "Race" definition). This entity serves as a selectable value for assigning traits to characters or other content items.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.Enums.TaskDifficultyEnum
files.Summary: Defines the perceived difficulty level of a task. Designed to be ADHD-friendly by providing clear, actionable complexity tiers.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.Enums.TaskPriorityEnum
files.Summary: Defines the priority level for tasks within a project workflow.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.Enums.TaskStatusEnum
files.Summary: Defines the lifecycle stages of a task within a project workflow.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.ProjectTask
files.Summary: Represents a discrete unit of work within a project's workflow. A task is anchored by its and is associated with a specific .

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.ProjectTaskComment
files.Summary: Represents a user-generated comment attached to a .

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Tasks.ProjectTaskMetaInfo
files.Summary: Serves as the identity anchor for a . This entity holds the core status, priority, and metadata required to manage task workflows.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.AttributeSetDefinition
files.Summary: Defines a predefined group of attributes (e.g., Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence) used in project templates. This allows for templated ability systems tailored to specific genres or game mechanics.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.ProjectTemplate
files.Summary: Represents a blueprint for creating new projects, defining preset structures and content requirements.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.TemplateAttributeSetDefinition
files.Summary: Links a to its parent . This entity facilitates the mapping of attribute sets within the templating system.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.TemplateClassTemplateDefinition
files.Summary: Defines a template for character classes within a project template. This allows for pre-configuring class structures (e.g., "Warrior", "Mage") including their level ranges and descriptions.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.TemplateIdentityDefinition
files.Summary: Defines the identity systems (e.g., Race, Faction, Guild) that are pre-configured for a project template. This ensures that any project created from this template has the appropriate identity categories ready for use.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Templates.TemplateNarrativeStructure
files.Summary: Defines a pre-configured narrative structure (e.g., Act Sequences, Plot Points) for a project template. This allows templates to provide ready-made story arcs and sequence arrangements for new projects.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.Character
files.Summary: Represents the primary entity for a character within the narrative structure. Acts as an aggregator that links identity (via ), static backstory (via ), and dynamic story progression (via ).

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.CharacterRelation
files.Summary: Represents an evolving relationship between two characters within the narrative. This is an event-driven junction entity that tracks how character connections change over time, often triggered by specific narrative events in a scene.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.CharacterRole
files.Summary: Defines the narrative roles a character can occupy within the story.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.CharacterState
files.Summary: Represents a character's mutable state at a specific point in the narrative. This entity tracks dynamic properties that can change as the story progresses, such as role, faction affiliation, location, and life status. A single character may have multiple records to track their evolution over different arcs or chapters.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.CharacterStatus
files.Summary: Defines the life status of a character within a specific narrative state.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.CharacterStoryProfile
files.Summary: Represents the permanent, static backstory and personality profile of a character. This entity holds immutable traits that define who the character is fundamentally, as opposed to their dynamic state which changes throughout the narrative.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Characters.RelationTypeEnum
files.Summary: Defines the types of relationships that can exist between characters.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Enums.LoreTypeEnum
files.Summary: Defines the categories of lore entries used for world-building.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Enums.OutlineStatusEnum
files.Summary: Defines the lifecycle stages of a story outline.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.DialogueBranch
files.Summary: Represents a distinct path or tree within a branching dialogue system. Used for interactive storytelling, visual novels, and RPG-style conversation trees.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.DialogueNode
files.Summary: Represents a single point in a dialogue tree. Contains the spoken text, the speaker, and potential branches for player/character choices.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.LoreEntry
files.Summary: Represents a piece of world-building information (lore) within a project. Used to document setting details, history, geography, and mythology.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.OutlineSection
files.Summary: Represents a structured section within a . Sections allow for organizing high-level ideas and beats into coherent groups.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.Scene
files.Summary: Represents a Scene - the fundamental "unit of work" for narrative writing. A scene contains raw markdown text and links to structural elements like story chapters, beats, segments, and evolving character states.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.SceneSegment
files.Summary: Represents a specific structural marker or "token" within a . Segments allow for indexing interactive elements (like dialogue, actions, or monologue) without relying on fragile text position indices.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.SceneStoryBeatMapping
files.Summary: Junction table representing the many-to-many relationship between a and its associated s. This allows a single scene to fulfill multiple narrative beats, and a beat to be satisfied across different scenes.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.SegmentType
files.Summary: Defines the functional types of segments available for scene structure.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.Story
files.Summary: Represents the overarching narrative work (e.g., a novel, screenplay, or campaign). A story is anchored by its identity and contains a hierarchical structure of outlines, beats, and chapters.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.StoryBeat
files.Summary: Represents a Story Beat - a "Landmark" or major keypoint within a story's structure. Beats serve as structural anchors that can be fulfilled by one or many scenes, acting as draggable cards in the planning interface.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.StoryChapter
files.Summary: Represents a major narrative segment (e.g., a chapter or act) within a story. Chapters provide structural organization for scenes and beats.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.StoryOutline
files.Summary: Represents a Story Outline - the high-level "Map" of a project's narrative intent. It serves as a container for planning, defining key story beats and organizing structural sections before full scenes are developed. Hierarchy: Project → StoryOutline → StoryBeat → Scene

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.Narrative.WritingTag
files.Summary: Defines tags used for categorizing and filtering writing content (e.g., genres or themes).

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.WorldBuilding.Faction
files.Summary: Represents a faction, organization, or group within the game world. Factions have defined ideologies and goals, and may be anchored to specific locations.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.WorldBuilding.LocationType
files.Summary: Defines the hierarchical classification levels for world locations.

files.Title: Gadema.Core.Models.Writing.WorldBuilding.WorldLocation
files.Summary: Represents a geographic location within the game world. Locations can be organized hierarchically (e.g., Country → Region → City) and track character presence.

files.Summary: Provides extension methods for enums to facilitate conversion to deterministic GUIDs.
